# WhatsClean 1.1.3
## Clearer confirmation
- When you move selected files to the Trash, the confirmation now shows the number of files and the space you will recover, as the seven-day cleanup already did.
## Localization
- The WhatsApp folder access window and its alerts now follow your macOS language, including Brazilian Portuguese.
## Reliability
- Test builds can no longer reach a real WhatsApp folder authorization; regression tests use only synthetic files. - Every change now runs through automated macOS checks: compilation, thirteen regression tests, packaging, and code signature validation.
Automatic cleanup, scheduling, and Trash behavior are unchanged.
Apple Silicon · macOS 12 or later · version 1.1.3, build 9.

# WhatsClean 1.1.2
## macOS Golden Gate compatibility
Updated for macOS Golden Gate, with automatic cleanup improvements validated on macOS 27.0.1 (Apple Silicon). The fixes focus on reliable scheduling after system updates, cleanup with the app closed, and handling access to WhatsApp media.
## Automatic cleanup fixes
- Auto (7d) works with WhatsClean closed, including when its menu bar icon is disabled. - Uses a daily calendar schedule at 10:00 local time, with catch-up after sleep and an immediate run when the schedule is loaded at login. Only recognized WhatsApp media older than seven days is moved to the Trash. - Repairs enabled schedules after app or macOS updates and uses modern launchd registration. - Keeps folder authorization active during both scanning and moves to the Trash. - Reports access failures and incomplete scans instead of silently treating them as successful cleanups. Local logs and JSON reports are available in `~/Library/Logs/WhatsClean/`. - Rechecks file age before moving items and preserves symbolic links and content outside the authorized media folder. - Adds a read-only diagnostic command and conditional permission guidance in Settings.
## Validation
- Twelve regression checks passed with synthetic files: selection/exclusions, read-only verification, Trash moves, preservation of recent or changed files, access failures, disabled cleanup, and calendar configuration. - Verified background execution with the app closed and a separate calendar-triggered read-only check on macOS 27.0.1.
Apple Silicon · macOS 12 or later · version 1.1.2, build 8.

# WhatsClean 1.1.1
## Auto (7d) fixes
- Fixed Auto (7d) waiting up to 24 hours before its first cleanup after being enabled or restored following an app update. - Automatic cleanup now runs once immediately when its LaunchAgent is loaded, then continues every 24 hours. - Fixed the enabled Auto (7d) button appearing gray even though its status said ON. - The active state now uses an explicit green style that remains visually clear across macOS appearances. - Updated the confirmation text to explain that the first eligible cleanup starts immediately.

# WhatsClean 1.1.0
## Welcome and localization
- Added a concise first-launch welcome screen explaining how WhatsClean works. - Added complete English and Brazilian Portuguese resources; WhatsClean follows the preferred language configured in macOS and falls back to English. - Added a reusable **Getting Started** guide under Settings, the app menu, and the menu bar icon.
## About and transparency
- Added a dedicated, resizable **About WhatsClean** window. - Clarified that WhatsClean does not need to stay open or continuously run in the background. - Explained that Auto (7d) uses a lightweight macOS scheduled task to move WhatsApp media older than seven days to the Trash once a day. - Added clear privacy, open-source, GitHub, and license information.
## Discoverability and build reliability
- Improved project and installation descriptions for GitHub, Homebrew, and search engines. - Added a lightweight public project page with software metadata and installation links. - Made legacy icon packaging reproducible while retaining the modern macOS Tahoe asset catalog.

# WhatsClean 1.0.4
## Bug fix
- Fixed automatic update checks not running immediately when WhatsClean was reopened. - When **Automatically check for updates** is enabled, WhatsClean now performs a silent update check at launch. - No “up to date” dialog is shown for automatic background checks; update alerts appear only when a new version is available. - Manual **Check for Updates Now** behavior remains unchanged.
